decision: Advance partial-permission suffix-capacity admission as a bounded capability question; shared all-partial extension is positive design only. Do not yet start RTL/BIT or claim performance/firstness.
accepted_positive_results: An unsplit ordered source read does not require all destination WRITE regions prepared upfront when the complete unprepared suffix Ui fits actual exclusive capacity Qi and the authorized prefix can drain independently.

Six actual Python finite-state cases match the root oracle on all reachable states, all edges and complete witness replay: frontier_N8 28/1terminal/0deadlock; knowingly inadmissible frontier_N9 24/0terminal/1deadlock(r8,w5,pfalse); full_prepare_N8/N9 31/35 states, no deadlock; split_source_N8/N9 34/38, no deadlock.

The all-partial shared extension can dispense with the old prototype full-WRITE sponsor under fully resident, independently authorized child service. Actual independent native concurrency card confirms the finite witness and group barrier counterexample. This is a conditional design, not a new shared graph or RTL run, and own-prototype limitation is not proof of publication novelty.

Whole-window null escrow adds a clear bound beyond perchildQ, but its generic credit basis is prior art and hand examples show fewer null at more AW plus a continuous-source regression. It is a safety/cost component, not an accepted performance innovation.
